At around 98 kg with a fold-down backrest, it's also practical to lift into a car with a hoist. This pre-owned chair comes with a kerb climber kit, swing-away joystick mount and swing-away footplate.

✅ Key Features & Benefits

  • More stable for taller and larger users
    Designed to resist tipping, with a 136 kg (21 st 6 lb) user limit, so you feel secure on slopes and uneven paths.

  • Kerb climber kit fitted
    Helps you get up small kerbs more easily, so you're less reliant on finding a dropped kerb.

  • Compact 580 x 1070 mm footprint
    Fits through narrower doorways and turns in a 1.7-metre circle at home.

  • Handles hills up to 8 degrees
    Larger castors and 14-inch knobbly solid tyres help on hilly, uneven ground — and never go flat.

  • Fold-down backrest, around 98 kg
    Makes the chair more practical to load into a car with a hoist.

  • Swing-away joystick mount and footplate
    Move them aside to get closer to a table or desk, or for easier transfers.

Who it suits best

  • Taller or larger users up to 21 st 6 lb (136 kg) who want a compact chair
  • You need an electric wheelchair (also known as a powerchair) that copes with hills and uneven paths
  • You plan to carry it in a car using a hoist

Worth knowing before you buy

This is a pre-owned chair, so it has had a previous owner; ask us about its condition when you call. It has a sling seat rather than a fully contoured seat, which suits many people but may not give enough support if you need specialist posture seating. It doesn't fold flat for a car boot — for that, look at a folding electric wheelchair.

Questions customers ask us

What size is the seat?
This chair's seat is set at 44 cm wide and 46 cm deep, with a seat-to-floor height of 47 cm.

How does it compare with the Q100 R?
The Q200 R is a little larger, with greater stability, bigger castors and better outdoor performance, and it suits taller and heavier users.

Can I see it before I buy?
Yes. Call us first so we can check it's in the showroom — if it isn't, we can usually arrange a demo model. You can also book a free home assessment.
